from pathlib import Path

path = Path('tinydb/utils.py')
source = path.read_text()
old = '''    def set(self, key: K, value: V):
        if self.cache.get(key):
            self.cache[key] = value

            # Check, if the cache is full and we have to remove old items
            # If the queue is of unlimited size, self.capacity is NaN and
            # x > NaN is always False in Python and the cache won't be cleared.
            if self.capacity is not None and self.length > self.capacity:
                self.cache.popitem(last=False)
        else:
            self.cache[key] = value
            self.cache.move_to_end(key, last=True)
'''
new = '''    def set(self, key: K, value: V):
        self.cache[key] = value
        self.cache.move_to_end(key, last=True)

        if self.capacity is not None:
            while self.length > self.capacity:
                self.cache.popitem(last=False)
'''
assert source.count(old) == 1
path.write_text(source.replace(old, new))

path = Path('tests/test_utils.py')
source = path.read_text()
old = '''        start = 0 if capacity is None else max(0, key + 1 - capacity)
        assert cache.lru == list(range(start, key + 1))
'''
new = '''        expected = list(range(key + 1))
        if capacity is not None:
            expected = expected[-capacity:] if capacity else []
        assert cache.lru == expected
'''
assert source.count(old) == 1
path.write_text(source.replace(old, new))
PY
